Alice: Scheduling a narrow schema change tonight for payments.transactions at 02:00 UTC. Add nullable `processed_at` + small chunked backfill. Window 02:00-03:00.
Ben: Rollback criteria?
Alice: Abort if sustained lock wait >5s for 3m, write errors >1% for 5m, or repl lag >12s. Abort steps: stop workers, flip feature flag to skip backfill writes, terminate backfill queries. Manual reverse migration if needed.
Carla: I'll implement chunked backfill (id > last_id LIMIT) with randomized sleep and ops flag to tune speed.
Dave: I'll run a preflight on 3 tenants at 01:20 and post timings.
Eve: I'll update release notes and ops playbook.
Ben: deploybot, schedule migration 2024-09-12T02:00Z, pin db-migrate v2.8.1 for canary. Canary slice 7%.
deploybot: Migration queued by @ben for 2024-09-12T02:00Z (db-migrate v2.8.1). Canary: 7% hashed tenants. Hooks: lockwatch, p99-db-latency, write-errors.
Dave: Preflight (01:20): sample 5k rows/tenant. avg row 1.0ms, p99 5ms, peak lock wait 0.6s, repl lag <0.5s. Charts: https://internal.ops/charts/4132470000
Ben: numbers look OK.
Carla: chunking flag ready to flip.
Alice: Runbook outline:
- preflight 01:20 (Dave)
- canary start 02:00 (7%)
- monitor: lock_wait, p99 latency, write_errors
- abort triggers + commands in playbook
- escalation: promote read-replica for reads + degraded write mode (queue to kafka)

deploybot: Canary started 02:00Z. Monitoring active.
Dave: Canary update 02:12: 7% slice complete, no alerts, p99 stable.
Alice: Proceed to 30% at 02:15 if stable for 10m.
Eve: Release notes draft shared.
Ben: tagging on-call @carla @dave for watch.
Alice: Final: promoted to 30% at 02:15. Will post final when done.
